name: Drakkenhob

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Irresistible Payment
traits.summary: An Influence action offering alcohol or any gold, with a DC 16 Persuasion check, makes it take the offer and use its Reaction to back away half its Speed.
traits.text: As an Influence action, a creature that offers the drakkenhob alcohol or any amount of gold and succeeds on a DC 16 Charisma (Persuasion) check forces it to accept the offer and immediately take a Reaction to move up to half its Speed away from that creature by the safest route.

actions.name: Terrifying Breath
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. 30-ft cone, DC 15 Wis save: 4d6 Psychic (half on a success); on a failure the target drops what it holds and is Frightened, Dashing away each turn (new save at the end of each of its turns, 1 minute at most).
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target drops whatever it is holding and has the Frightened condition. A Frightened target takes the Dash action and moves away from the drakkenhob by the safest route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to go. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success; after 1 minute it succeeds automatically. Success: half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Call the Hounds
bonus_actions.summary: Howls up three hunting hounds (Wolf blocks) in free spaces within 60 ft; they act right after it and vanish if they or it drop to 0 HP or it calls again.
bonus_actions.text: The drakkenhob howls and magically summons three hunting hounds, using the Wolf stat block, in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of it. The hounds take their turn immediately after the drakkenhob on the same Initiative count and obey its mental commands. They vanish when they or the drakkenhob drop to 0 Hit Points, or when it uses this Bonus Action again.

minions.narration: The costumed hounds fade as the drakkenhob falls.

summary: A dragon in a festival hobby-horse costume that rends with psychic fangs, howls up a pack of costumed hounds and breathes a wave of terror; gold or drink sends it off.
